title: Blinkit refused to replace or return a useless extension board
text: I recently ordered an extension board from Blinkit for my MacBook charger. When it arrived, I found that the socket design doesn't allow the Apple charger to fit properly, making the extension board completely unusable for me. I contacted Blinkit support immediately, explained the issue, and even shared photos. Instead of offering a replacement or return, they simply kept saying, We can't help with this. No replacement, no refund, no solution.

title: HELP! Ice cream order got cancelled after I ate it
text: I ordered ice cream on blinkit. The order got delayed that's why I requested to cancel it. But before cancellation occured I recieved the order. After I ate it the order got cancelled and refunded. The delivery boy came back and demanded the product back. I explained him the situation he said his licence will get cancelled due to this. Customer care said to give the refund amount to delivery guy and asked the delivery guy to submit it to the store.

title: Blinkit didn't print 35 of 73 pages
text: I placed an order of printing 73 pages of a PDF. Since I trusted them, I had done printing before, I didn't check each and every page after the order arrived. However, when I finally started counting the pages, I found out that they didn't send me the 35 pages remaining of the book. Since replacement/refund is only for 3 days, the virtual assistant didn't help me.

title: Extremely similar but incorrect item delivered
text: I ordered a bunch of fizzy drinks, ice creams and chocolates. One of the drinks was a UK import lemon and lime pepsi max. When it arrived, I realised it was a Vietnamese version of the same flavour. I thought I must have clicked on the wrong item. Today, I ordered it again, made sure it was the UK version. The thumbnail had the typical short and stubby 330ml british fizzy drink can. I know what I ordered, and that is not what I received.

title: Blinkit support wants me to attach sense of smell/taste to email
text: I ordered cut pineapple slices from Blinkit. Once we received the order, we opened the pineapple box, and the stench hit us all. It smelled very bad, was bitter in taste, and was soggy at the edges. I raised a request on Blinkit, marking the pineapple as rotten. The representative said from the images, we can't verify that what you received is rotten or not. He said we can only process a refund after verifying that the product has a bad smell and taste, and your images cannot prove that.

title: What to do if blinkit sent you extra items?
text: Today I ordered some things from blinkit, including yakult, I ordered 1 pack, bro came with multiple in the bag, I didn't even realise until I brought the bag inside, and he was gone. He even forgot his blinkit bag at my gate. My main question is, what do I do with them? Can blinkit contact me to take them back?

title: Good delivery experience - airfryer with a snake!
text: Never ordered anything more than 3k on blinkit! Today I ordered an airfryer! So at first they assigned one guy for this job then I refreshed and saw actually there are 2 guys assigned! One was holding that airfryer and another was driving! Then these 2 came. Just thought to share this experience!

title: Something very weird and creepy happened with me on blinkit
text: I was on my phone when I saw a message saying I had ordered something from blinkit, thought it was a scam message until I opened my blinkit account and saw someone had actually ordered something from my blinkit account and it was not me, it was not even my location or city or state. I got scared and canceled the order immediately. I'm confused how did he get the access to my account?

title: Pathetic product handling
text: Have ordered from so many quick commerce apps but it's always Blinkit that doesn't handle the products well. Many a time the bags aren't sealed or overpacked or dirty or torn and almost all the time the food products are either smashed or broken or the packaging is dirty. It's unhygienic and also frustrating.

title: Product quality deteriorating
text: The quality of products on Blinkit has been deteriorating over the past few months. Items arrive damaged, packaging is poor, and customer support is unhelpful. They refuse refunds even when items are clearly defective.

title: Forced to accept replacement instead of refund
text: Ordered groceries and received expired products. When I raised a complaint, they only offered replacement instead of refund. The replacement also came with issues. Customer support just keeps saying the same scripted responses.

title: Delivery partner behaviour issues
text: The delivery partner called me multiple times asking for exact location even though the address was clear. Then he got rude when I told him the pin location was correct. This happens frequently with Blinkit deliveries.

title: Good for emergency orders but overpriced
text: Blinkit is good when you need something urgently. But the prices are significantly higher than local stores and even other apps. The convenience comes at a steep premium. Would not recommend for regular grocery shopping.

title: Missing items and no accountability
text: Ordered 15 items and only received 12. When I complained, they said the items were out of stock and would be refunded. The refund took 5 days and they offered no compensation for the inconvenience. This happens almost every other order.

title: Vegetables quality is poor
text: The vegetables and fruits on Blinkit are often not fresh. I have received wilted lettuce, soft tomatoes, and overripe bananas multiple times. They show nice pictures in the app but deliver substandard quality produce.

title: Convenient but needs category expansion
text: Blinkit is super convenient for daily essentials and snacks. But they really need to expand their categories. I wish they had more variety in pet supplies, baby products, and personal care items. Currently I have to go to Amazon or local stores for those.

title: Account security concerns
text: My account was accessed by someone else and orders were placed from a different city. Blinkit's response was lukewarm. They asked me to change my password but didn't explain how the breach happened. Very concerning for an app that has my payment details.

title: 10-minute delivery is great but at what cost
text: The speed is impressive. But I often wonder about the pressure on delivery partners. I've seen riders rush through traffic dangerously. The 10-minute promise seems to come at the cost of rider safety. Also, products sometimes arrive damaged because of the rush.

title: Refund process is terrible
text: Got a damaged product and requested a refund. The app showed refund initiated but nothing came to my bank account for 7 days. Had to follow up multiple times through chat. Each time I got a different response. Finally got the refund but the process is exhausting.

title: Wrong product delivered and no return option
text: Ordered a specific brand of cooking oil and received a completely different brand. When I tried to return, the app said returns are not available for this category. So I'm stuck with a product I didn't order and Blinkit takes no responsibility.

title: App crashes frequently
text: The Blinkit app crashes frequently, especially during peak hours or flash sales. I've lost items from my cart multiple times because the app restarted. The search function also doesn't work well - often can't find products that are actually available.

title: Delivery delays during rain
text: Blinkit's 10-minute promise goes out the window during rain. My order took 45 minutes during light rain. I understand weather challenges but they should adjust the estimated time instead of showing 10 minutes and then keep delaying.

title: Great for late night needs
text: I frequently order from Blinkit late at night. The availability of items at midnight is impressive. Got medicines, snacks, and even phone charger at 2 AM. This is where Blinkit really shines over traditional stores.

title: Subscription auto-renewal without consent
text: Blinkit renewed my subscription without sending any notification. They charged my card automatically. When I asked for cancellation and refund, they said they can cancel future renewals but won't refund the current charge. This feels like a scam.

title: Product images don't match what you receive
text: The images shown for products in the app are often very different from what actually gets delivered. Especially for fruits and vegetables. The tomatoes in the picture look farm-fresh but what arrives is often bruised and old.

title: Blinkit vs Zepto vs Instamart comparison
text: I've tried all three platforms. Blinkit has the fastest delivery but the poorest product quality. Zepto has better quality but fewer options. Instamart has the best prices. I use different apps based on what I need. For speed, Blinkit. For quality, Zepto.

title: Fake discounts on Blinkit
text: Blinkit shows MRP prices as original and their selling price as discounted. But when you check the same product at a local store, the MRP itself is lower. They inflate MRP to show fake discounts. Very deceptive pricing strategy.

title: Customer support bot is useless
text: The customer support chatbot on Blinkit is absolutely useless. It goes in circles with pre-written responses. Getting to a human agent is nearly impossible. When you finally get one, they just copy-paste the same responses. Zero empathy, zero resolution.

title: Perfect for weekly grocery shopping
text: I've been using Blinkit for my weekly grocery shopping for 6 months now and it's been great. The prices are competitive, delivery is fast, and the quality has been consistent. I rarely need to visit a physical store anymore.

title: Near-expiry products being sold
text: Multiple times I've received products that are very close to their expiry date. Once got milk that was expiring the same day. This is not acceptable. They're clearly clearing old inventory through their platform.

title: Would love more brand options in personal care
text: Blinkit has good groceries but their personal care and beauty section is very limited. Only 2-3 brands for most categories. I end up ordering from Amazon for skincare and haircare. If they expanded, I'd happily buy everything from one place.

title: Packaging is wasteful
text: Every small item comes in a separate plastic bag. Ordered 5 items and got 5 plastic bags plus the main bag. This is extremely wasteful. Quick commerce is terrible for the environment. They should offer eco-friendly packaging options.

title: Discovered pet food section recently
text: I didn't know Blinkit had pet supplies! Just discovered they carry dog food and treats. The selection is small but being able to get pet food delivered in 10 minutes when you run out is amazing. Hope they expand this category.

title: Charged for items never delivered
text: My order showed as delivered but I never received 3 items from the order. The delivery partner marked everything as delivered. Customer support refused to believe me and denied the refund. Had to dispute through my bank.

title: New categories keep appearing
text: I've noticed Blinkit keeps adding new categories like electronics, toys, and even printing services. The selection in new categories is still limited but it's interesting to see them expand beyond groceries. Tried the printing service and it was decent.

title: Dark store quality varies by area
text: The quality of products varies a lot depending on which dark store serves your area. When I order from my home, the products are great. But at my office location, the same products come in poor condition. Very inconsistent.

title: Delivery partner asked for cash tip
text: The delivery partner explicitly asked me for a cash tip after delivery. When I said I already tipped in the app, he got annoyed and said app tips don't reach them fully. This made me uncomfortable. Blinkit should address this.

title: Blinkit during Diwali was a lifesaver
text: Used Blinkit extensively during festivals. Getting last-minute puja items, sweets, and decorations delivered in minutes was incredible. This is where quick commerce really proves its value.

title: Items marked as out of stock too often
text: Half the items in my cart become out of stock by the time I checkout. It's frustrating to build a cart only to find multiple items unavailable. The inventory system needs improvement.

title: Tried buying electronics from Blinkit
text: Ordered a USB cable and earphones from Blinkit. The quality was okay for the price. Wouldn't buy expensive electronics here but for accessories and small items it's convenient. The return policy for electronics is unclear though.

title: Blinkit charged twice for one order
text: I was charged twice for the same order. The app showed only one transaction but my bank showed two deductions. Getting the double charge reversed took 10 days and multiple follow-ups. Unacceptable payment handling.

title: Love the reorder feature
text: The reorder feature on Blinkit is super helpful. I order the same groceries every week and being able to just tap reorder saves so much time. Wish they'd add a recurring auto-order option too.

title: No proper invoice for business purchases
text: I use Blinkit for office supplies but they don't provide proper GST invoices. The receipts are basic and don't have the details needed for business expense claims. This limits its usefulness for business purchasing.

title: Night delivery safety concerns
text: Ordered late at night and the delivery partner called saying he couldn't find the address. I had to go outside to meet him. As a woman living alone, this felt unsafe. The app should have better navigation for delivery partners.

title: Pricing varies throughout the day
text: I've noticed that prices on Blinkit change during the day. Items can be cheaper in the morning and more expensive during peak evening hours. It feels like surge pricing for groceries. Not cool.
